reforms.description: The reduction of capital requirements for new start-ups in 2003 from 3 million yen to only 1 yen contributed to a 10 percent rise in the number of newly created companies.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Lowering capital requirements encourages entrepreneurship and the formation of new businesses, which can enhance economic dynamism and job creation.
reforms.status_evidence: The reduction in capital requirements led to a significant increase in new company formations.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform significantly lowered barriers to entry for new businesses, fostering a more vibrant startup ecosystem.
reforms.source_quote: Another important reform was the reduction of the capital requirements for new start-ups in 2003 from 3 million yen (10 million yen for companies that issue stock) to only 1 yen.
